annotations.title: Suggest a piece for an occasion

description: Suggest pieces suited to an occasion or a mood, such as a birthday, a thank-you, the end of a project, a launch, a welcome or a farewell. Useful when an agent wants a small gift for its person. Free. Returns suggestions with reasons, previews and buy URLs.

occasion.description: The occasion or mood, in plain words, e.g. "birthday", "thank you for the help", "we shipped the project".

recipient.description: Optional: a few words about who it is for, used only to vary the suggestion.
